text:
incident-bot: P1 - Solace (enterprise) reporting elevated 5xx error rate across eu-west-1 inference endpoints. Incident created. Pager: @alice-tilman. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/enterprise-failover

alice-tilman: ack. joining bridge now. creating support bridge -> https://meet.redwood/bridges/3425678901

dana-se: from SE: customer seeing ~12% 5xx for authenticated sessions, some tenant-specific errors. They're on the bridge (SE: @se-solace).

se-solace: on bridge — affected customer apps see session errors, spikes coincide with scheduled model swap earlier this morning. Asking for minimal downtime.

raj-patel: looking at runtime metrics — dp-solace-eu1-01 showing repeated model worker OOMs and process restarts. Other pool nodes are healthy but scheduler is slowly draining requests off the node. Logs: `worker-oom: model=redwood-xxlarge step=generate memory=31.9GB`

emma-ops: infra: we have a warm pool dp-solace-eu1-warm2 in eu-west that can handle full traffic. Need to validate model variant and KV cache priming. ETA to warm up containers ~6-8m.

kevin-td: support: current public DNS for solace-prod-eu is TTL=300. recommend TTL=30 for cutover window so DNS changes propagate quickly. who will own the DNS change? provider is ns1.

alice-tilman: tentative mitigation plan — keep it short:
1) provision & validate warm nodes (emma)
2) prime KV/prefix cache for top customer prefixes (raj)
3) reduce DNS TTL to 30 (kevin) while warmup is ongoing
4) perform staged traffic-weight shift (10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%) with 90s observation windows
5) if 5xx drops to baseline, keep new routing and raise TTL back later
Rollback criteria: >=5% sustained 5xx increase or auth failures from customer.

raj-patel: priming step: running warm-priming job now:
```
prime-cache --tenant solace --model redwood-xxlarge --prefix-file /tmp/top-500-prefixes.txt
```
progress: ~45% primed, cache hitrate trending up.

emma-ops: provisioning finished. dp-solace-eu1-warm2 nodes are up, healthchecks green (`/healthz` 200). GPU temps normal. ready for routing tests.

se-solace: customer on bridge approves staged cutover once first 10% is healthy. They request closed-loop confirmation between each step.

kevin-td: changed DNS TTL to 30 at ns1. change id `chg-9876`.

alice-tilman: initiating first traffic shift. Routing command (internal):
```
rtrctl set-weight cluster:dp-solace-eu1 10 --target solace-prod-eu
```
Applying now.

incident-bot: Routing change event recorded: rtrctl by alice-tilman at 3425679142.

raj-patel: first 10% shifted. error rate dropped from 12% -> 3.2% within 90s. no auth errors observed. KV cache hit stable.

se-solace: confirming with customer — their telemetry shows large drop in errors, sessions reconnected OK. :thumbsup:

alice-tilman: proceeding to 25% in 2m if metrics remain stable.

raj-patel: 25% -> metrics look good. 5xx now 0.8% ambient. CPU/gpu load on warm pool ~55%.

emma-ops: monitoring network and internal LB. No backend throttles.

alice-tilman: moving to 50% now. watch for auth flakiness.

raj-patel: 50% -> steady. initiating final 100% ramp in 2m.

kevin-td: reminder: TTL still 30, will keep it during the window.

se-solace: customer approves final ramp. they want a short note to their SREs when done.

alice-tilman: executing final ramp to 100%.
```
rtrctl set-weight cluster:dp-solace-eu1 100 --target solace-prod-eu
```

incident-bot: Routing change event recorded: rtrctl by alice-tilman at 3425679300.

raj-patel: all traffic now on warm pool. 5xx baseline ~0.3%. latency within SLO. KV cache hit ~98%.

se-solace: customer confirms resolved on their side. thanks team.

alice-tilman: changing DNS back to TTL=300 in 10m after stabilization. kevin, please handle.

kevin-td: scheduled TTL bump at ns1 in 10m (chg-9876-update).

alice-tilman: handing incident to @raj-patel for post-cutover validation & runbook updates. I'll stay for customer comms for another 20m.

raj-patel: will run through checklist and open a short postmortem. initial notes: cause = memory pressure during model swap plus a single node that didn't evict gracefully. mitigations: improve process restart backoff, add healthcheck enforcer for model-worker OOMs, document warm-priming as pre-swap step for enterprise tenants.

dana-se: I'll send a customer-facing timeline + what we did via the account channel and copy the SE.

alice-tilman: incident resolved for now. keeping bridge open until TTL restored. creating incident ticket INC-342567 and assigning PM for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Severity P1 -> mitigated at 3425679363.

emma-ops: notes for SREs: dp-solace-eu1-01 flagged for deeper forensic; don't redeploy model there until root cause confirmed.

kevin-td: closing support alert once TTL bump confirmed and customer ack received.

se-solace: customer thanks the team, will expect postmortem.

alice-tilman: thanks all. good coordination. follow-ups: postmortem + runbook edits + warm pool pre-swap gating.
